import AiInfo, {
	nutritionFacts,
	dataPermissionLevels,
	aiInformation,
} from "@instructure.ai/aiinfo";

const uid: keyof typeof AiInfo = "smartsearch";
const name: string = nutritionFacts[uid].featureName;
const permission: string = dataPermissionLevels[uid].currentFeature;
const data: typeof AiInfo.smartsearch.aiInformation = aiInformation[uid];
console.log(name, permission, data);
